title: Setting Up Verifone As Your Payment Gateway | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Setting Up Verifone As Your Payment Gateway Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000010258 For the best results Stripe is the recommended payment gateway . However, for those who would like to setup 2checkout as their payment gateway, follow the steps below after entering payment gateway credentials . Setup The Instant Notification Settings After logging in to the account, click on the 'Instant Notification' Setting icon on the top navigation: In the Global Settings field, enter the following URL, replacing " www.domain.com " with the domain of the website: http:// www.domain.com /checkout/notifications/2checkout For example, if the domain of the website is www.marys-website.com then the following URL must be entered into this field: http:// www.marys-website.com /checkout/notifications/2checkout Click on "Apply" and "Save Settings" button: Setup The Checkout Options Click the "Account" button in the top navigation area and then the "Site Management" button below: Fill out all of the options on this page with the information relevant to the website. In the "Direct Return" section of the options, select "Header Redirect": Click on the "Save Changes" button in the bottom-right portion of the screen to save these settings. After completing this, the 2Checkout account should be all setup to accept payments through Brilliant Directories websites. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
